Re-Identification Risk Scoring and K-Anonymity Assessment

Source: R/deid-risk.R
dicom_deid_risk.Rd

Evaluates re-identification risk metrics across a cohort of DICOM studies by grouping subjects into quasi-identifier equivalence classes. Computes \(k\)-anonymity, \(\ell\)-diversity, maximum prosecutor risk, journalist risk, and marketer risk in compliance with HIPAA Expert Determination and privacy engineering standards.

Usage

dicom_deid_risk(
  path,
  quasi_ids = c("PatientSex", "PatientAge", "Modality", "StudyYear"),
  sensitive_attr = "BodyPartExamined",
  k_threshold = 5L
)

Arguments

path

Character vector of DICOM file paths, or a directory path.

quasi_ids

Character vector of DICOM keywords or attributes acting as quasi-identifiers (e.g. c("PatientSex", "PatientAge", "Modality", "StudyYear")).

sensitive_attr

Character string specifying the sensitive clinical attribute used for \(\ell\)-diversity calculation (default is "BodyPartExamined").

k_threshold

Integer minimum acceptable cell size \(k\) (default is 5L). Equivalence classes with \(k < k\_threshold\) are flagged.

Value

An S3 object of class "dicom_deid_risk" containing:

k_min

Integer minimum equivalence class size (\(k\)-anonymity).

l_min

Integer minimum number of distinct sensitive values (\(\ell\)-diversity).

max_prosecutor_risk

Numeric maximum prosecutor re-identification risk (\(1 / k_{min}\)).

journalist_risk

Numeric journalist risk (proportion of singleton subjects with \(k = 1\)).

marketer_risk

Numeric marketer risk (average re-identification probability across cohort).

k_threshold

Integer threshold applied.

n_subjects

Total number of unique subjects in the cohort.

n_equivalence_classes

Total number of distinct equivalence classes.

equivalence_classes

Tibble detailing each equivalence class, its \(k\) size, \(\ell\) diversity, and member subjects.

flagged_subjects

Character vector of subject IDs belonging to under-protected equivalence classes (\(k < k\_threshold\)).

flagged_patients

Alias for flagged_subjects.

quasi_ids

Character vector of active quasi-identifiers.

sensitive_attr

Active sensitive attribute.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
rk <- dicom_deid_risk("path/to/cohort", k_threshold = 5L)
print(rk)
if (rk$k_min < 5L) {
  message("Cohort requires generalization for: ", paste(rk$flagged_subjects, collapse = ", "))
}
} # }
